SimpleDesc: [Sacred Downpour] - Enemy Imbalanced + Tap QTE\nLiv: Empyrea quickly ascends into the air and fires multiple enhanced light projectiles at enemies. If all projectiles hit, triggers an additional explosion.

Name: Nighttime Prayer
Desc: [Nighttime Prayer] - 4 [Chant Stacks] + Tap Skill 3 Liv: Empyrea performs an Empyreal Prayer, summoning a healing array from above to restore her own HP, then releases beams of light that heal all allies. - Restores HP equal to 30% of Liv's max HP to all allied units on the battlefield. - Gains 20 Signature Energy. - Liv gains 20% DMG Reduction when casting. [Azure Firmament] - [Empyrea Form] + Tap Skill 3 Liv: Empyrea deploys [Azure Firmament] and heals all allies. - Restores HP equal to 30% of Liv's max HP to all allied units on the battlefield. - [Azure Firmament]: Allies within the area gain 90% DMG Reduction. - Gains 20 Signature Energy. - Liv gains 20% DMG Reduction when casting.
SimpleDesc: [Nighttime Prayer] - Tap Skill 3 Liv: Empyrea performs an Empyreal Prayer, summoning a healing array from above to restore her own HP, then releases beams of light that heal all allies. - Enters [Empyrea Form], then switches to [Azure Firmament]. [Azure Firmament] - Empyrea Form + Tap Skill 3 Liv: Empyrea deploys Azure Firmament, and heals all allies.

Name: Crimson Crown
Desc: [Crimson Crown] - 4 [Chant Stacks] + Tap Skill 4 Liv: Empyrea pushes beyond her limits, activating the Omega Module and granting all allied units Cleansing. - Increases all allied units' damage by 60% for 10s. - Gains 30 Signature Energy. - Liv gains 20% DMG Reduction when casting.
SimpleDesc: [Crimson Crown] - 4 [Chant Stacks] + Tap Skill 4\nLiv: Empyrea pushes beyond her limits, activating the Omega Module and granting all allied units Cleansing.
